records.label: Cinematic film still
records.visual_function: Frame the subject as one still from a high-budget film: shallow focus, moody grade, widescreen feel, and restrained film grain.
records.prompt: Compose the image as a cinematic film still: shallow depth of field isolating the subject, a gentle vignette, moody controlled color grading, widescreen cinematic framing, soft film grain, and high-budget production polish.
invariants: one selective focus plane carries the subject
the grade stays coherent across the whole frame
grain stays fine and photographic
misreadings_to_avoid: flat even video lighting erasing the mood
oversaturated punchy contrast replacing the grade
sharp deep focus contradicting the cinematic look

records.label: Analog film photograph
records.visual_function: Give the frame a faded analog film character: desaturated color response, visible grain, vignette, and vintage stock artifacts.
records.prompt: Render the image as an analog film photograph: gently faded desaturated color, visible organic grain, a soft corner vignette, slight vintage color shift, and the warm imperfect character of a 35mm print.
invariants: color response stays gently faded while the hues stay identifiable
grain stays organic and even
the vignette stays soft and peripheral
misreadings_to_avoid: digital cleanliness erasing the film character
heavy sepia wash replacing subtle fading
artificial scratch overlays reading as damage

records.label: Film noir monochrome
records.visual_function: Stage the frame as 1940s film noir: hard monochrome contrast, dramatic slatted shadows, and mystery-forward staging.
records.prompt: Render the image as film noir: high-contrast monochrome, hard directional light carving dramatic shadows, venetian-blind or window-slat shadow patterns where natural, deep blacks with selective bright accents, and a mysterious 1940s cinematic mood.
invariants: monochrome value design carries the whole image
one hard key light explains every shadow
blacks stay deep while the subject stays readable within them
misreadings_to_avoid: gray low-contrast mush instead of hard noir contrast
color leaking into the monochrome design
flat frontal light erasing the dramatic shadows

records.label: Long exposure motion streaks
records.visual_function: Hold the still elements sharp while moving elements streak into smooth luminous trails.
records.prompt: Render the image as a long-exposure photograph: stationary elements tack sharp, moving elements drawn into smooth directional streaks and light trails, a dreamlike ghosting on semi-still motion, and coherent streak direction across the frame.
invariants: static elements stay sharp as the anchor
every streak follows one coherent motion direction
trails stay smooth and luminous
misreadings_to_avoid: global blur destroying the sharp anchor
jittery broken streaks reading as camera shake
streaks contradicting the scene's motion directions

records.label: Tilt-shift miniature effect
records.visual_function: Make the scene read as a tiny model through a narrow sharp band and strong defocus above and below it.
records.prompt: Render the scene with a tilt-shift miniature effect: one narrow horizontal band of sharp focus on the subject, strong smooth defocus above and below, slightly boosted color saturation, and a high vantage that supports the toy-model illusion.
invariants: exactly one sharp focus band crosses the frame
defocus grows smoothly away from the band
the camera stays elevated above the scene
misreadings_to_avoid: full-frame sharpness erasing the miniature read
defocus bands at contradictory angles
eye-level camera defeating the model illusion

records.label: Neon noir night street
records.visual_function: Stage a dark rainy night scene carved by saturated neon signage, wet reflections, and low ambient light.
records.prompt: Render the image as neon noir: a dark low-ambient night scene lit mainly by saturated neon signs, wet streets and surfaces mirroring the colored light, high contrast between glow and shadow, and a moody rain-washed atmosphere.
invariants: neon sources explain every strong color in the frame
wet surfaces mirror the actual sign colors
ambient light stays low so the neon carves the scene
misreadings_to_avoid: daylight ambience flattening the neon contrast
colored glow with no visible source
dry surfaces ignoring the rain-washed mood

records.label: Clean studio product presentation
records.visual_function: Present the subject as a commercial product shot: seamless backdrop, controlled soft lighting, and edge-defining reflections.
records.prompt: Render the image as a clean studio product photograph: a seamless single-color backdrop, large soft key light with gentle fill, a subtle ground reflection or soft contact shadow anchoring the subject, crisp edge definition, and even commercial polish.
invariants: the backdrop stays seamless and uncluttered
one soft key plus fill explains the lighting
the subject stays anchored by shadow or reflection
misreadings_to_avoid: environmental props leaking into the seamless set
harsh mixed shadows from contradictory sources
floating subject with no ground contact cue

records.label: Knolling flat lay arrangement
records.visual_function: Arrange items in a tidy top-down grid: parallel alignment, even spacing, and organized flat-lay clarity.
records.prompt: Compose the image as a knolling flat lay: a directly top-down camera over items arranged in a neat parallel grid, even spacing between every object, a clean uniform surface beneath, and soft even shadowless lighting.
invariants: the camera looks straight down
items align parallel or at right angles
spacing stays even and deliberate
misreadings_to_avoid: perspective tilt breaking the top-down grid
overlapping items destroying the knolling order
hard shadows crowding the arrangement
